newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent flat, seeks direction amid range trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent flat, seeks direction amid range trade.

text.p: June Brent crude futures were quoted around the London close in Asia at midday on Tuesday amid a mostly steady NYMEX crude market.
Brokers said they were looking for direction as the market continues to range trade.
Shell said it had negotiated the restart of Forcados production, but the news was absorbed by London trading.
At 0425 GMT, June Brent trading on SIMEX was quoted at $18.10/$18.37 per barrel after London settled unchanged overnight at $18.27.
NYMEX June crude oil, trading on the ACCESS screen system, was last traded at $19.89 per barrel, down just two cents from New York.
Technically, June Brent is at the top end of the recent trading range of the front-month position, which has ranged $17.50/$18.60.
The June position has created a chart gap between $18.64 and $18.77 per barrel, which brokers said needs to be filled to build confidence on the upside.
